notes: Added _storage_ for up to five items, accessible near the entrance on every floor.
Stored items survive death if you resurrect. Starting a new game resets storage.
Fixed storage inspection details and storage not appearing on every floor.
The _Rogue_ is immune to a Mimic's gold theft.
Added the _FlameBow_, which sets targets on fire when its arrows hit.
The Mage's _Spirituality_ skill allows one additional summon for every three points invested.
Added skill descriptions to the class selection screen for quick reference.
Added the _Potion of Mana_, which fully restores mana.
Greatly reduced active skill cooldowns.
Active skills can be used while _starving_.
Published the source code on _SourceForge_.
Updated to vanilla _Pixel Dungeon 1.9.2a_.
Completely overhauled _skills_.
Published the code on _GitHub_ and updated the wiki.
The _quick skill button_ appears after casting or summoning.
Fixed a crash when champions hit summoned units.
Fixed an exploit that granted unlimited skill points.
Fixed _Spirituality_ not saving its level correctly.
Mage summons are weaker but last longer, with a limit of _3 plus Summoner level_.
The _Summoner_ skill no longer increases the number of units created by each cast.
Casting and summoning skills now take time.
Fixed a crash when _Knock Back_ pushed a unit out of bounds.
Crash fixes.
Added _mercenaries_.
Added _Just Kill Me_ difficulty.
Bug fixes.
Fixed restoring previous donations.
Fixed the mercenary death animation.
Fixed a crash caused by healing potions.
Fixed the Warrior's _Knock Back_ skill.
Bows can be _enchanted_.
Arrows spawn on every non-boss floor.
Added _Cupid arrows_ and _soul crystals_.
Summoned units are saved with their floor and restored when loading.
Fixed mercenary respawning, summoning and death animation bugs.
Mob stats and champion settings can be changed in-game, without making them easier than the current difficulty.
Reworked the UI to make _skills_ easier to manage.
Added animations when _HP and MP_ bars decrease.
Added a _new level_ and the _Cold Girl_ story.
Added the first _cutscene_.
The _Rat King_ can adjust mob defense.
UI tweaks.
Fixed a hunger bug caused by the cutscene.
Reworked the _Ice Girl_ fight to end earlier and avoid confusion.
The trailer cutscene can be opened from the title screen.
Fixed the HP bar animation when healing.
Fixed minor graphical issues in skill images.
The _skills window_ stays open after investing a point.
Added the first _scenario_.
Fixed the HP bar animation when using vampiric weapons.
Added a stabbing animation for melee attacks.
Remastered the first _scenario_.
Fixed the _Scroll of Skill_ not dropping.
Fixed _VAMP champions_ almost never spawning.
Increased drop chances for Skillful Pixel Dungeon items.
Fixed the Huntress's _Iron Tip_ blocking double and triple arrows.
Improved storage placement.
Replaced the Mage's _Summon Crab_ skill with _Spark_ in new games.
Fixed _Iron Tip_ blocking Bombvoyage and corrected Bombvoyage's mana cost.
The _Scroll Holder_ can hold Scrolls of Wipe and now has 18 slots.
Added a _shop on floor 1_. Shops sell soul crystals.
The _Rogue_ starts with a Dual Blade.
Fixed _Bombvoyage_ being unusable.
Replaced the Rogue's _Dead Eye_ skill with _Double Strike_.
The Mage's _Spark_ replaces Summon Crab in new games.
Fixed getting stuck while descending into shop levels.
Fixed the Huntress defaulting to arrow damage.
Fixed captured units losing their skill after loading.
The _Necroblade's_ charge bonus damage is no longer fixed.
Crash fixes.
Fixed the game sometimes freezing when interacting with _mercenaries_.
Mercenaries can no longer equip class-specific epic armor.
Fixed skills such as _Spark_ and _KO Arrow_ losing levels when loading a game.
Fixed a _Mind Vision_ potion crash when a mercenary was not visible.
Added a safeguard to mercenary AI to prevent the game freezing.
The _Rat King_ can control Day and Night modes.
Fixed the campaign and _Cold Girl_ quest corrupting Rogue saves.
Buffed _Spark_: more damage and a chance to blind.
Nerfed the Mage's _Sorcerer_ skill.
Added _weapon skills_.
_Barbaric weapons_ have a 20% chance to cast level 1 Smite.
Dropped weapons have a 50% chance to be barbaric.
Fixed a crash caused by hunger.
Updated the game icon.
Fixed crashes related to missions and checking unit visibility.
Removed unused imports to reduce APK size.
Fixed crashes in the game log, swap effect and wound animation.
Fixed a crash in _Cold Girl_ AI.
Reduced the Rogue's _Shadow Clone_ lifespan by 33%.
Doubled Shadow Clone's mana cost and reduced clone damage.
More crash fixes.
Fixed a conflict between _Rogue and Huntress saves_.
Some existing saves could be lost; future saves avoid this conflict.
Added _Super Easy_ difficulty.
New _Shadow Clones_ can be attacked, and their strength depends on skill level.
Increased _Awareness_ dodge chance to 25% per level.
Removed some starting items.
Crash fixes.
Disabled the _Cold Girl_ quest pending a rework.
Added the _Call Merc_ button.
Fixed difficulty damage modifiers not applying to shamans and evil eyes.
Removed marsupial rats' ranged attack.
_Super Easy_ starts with three soul crystals; _Easy_ starts with two.
Increased damage taken from mobs on Super Easy.
Reduced _Shadow Clone_ health and slightly reduced its mana cost.
Crash fixes.
Fixed warlock difficulty damage modifiers.
Harder difficulties start with more skill points.
Bows can be _upgraded_ to deal more damage.
The _Huntress_ starts with an upgraded bow and 15 extra arrows.
Replaced _Soul Arrow_ with _Aimed Shot_, which never misses and deals more damage.
Huntress changes apply to new games.
Crash fixes.
Difficulty options are _Easy, Normal and Hell_.
Hidden doors and traps are easier to discover on Easy.
The _Rat King_ sells food, with prices based on the deepest floor reached.
Crash fixes.
Replaced the Rogue's _Smoke Bomb_ with _Ninja Bomb_, a tier 2 active skill.
Ninja Bomb can put targets to sleep, but does not work on bosses.
_Double Stab_ is now tier 1.
Crash fixes.
Crash fixes.
Fixed a crash caused by mob emote icons.
Fixed a null pointer crash when saving the game.
_Betrayal_ scenario added
Fixed _Hatsune's echoes_ being invisible
_Necroblade_ replaces _Consume_ with _Dark Bolt_ after level 5
_Dark Bolt_ kills non-boss monsters and summons a slave
Number of available skills show in overlay
Skill _cool down_ added
Skills remain active but do not trigger when on cool down
Skills cannot be cast when on cool down
_Quick skill button_ shows cool down of last skill
_Potion Holder_ added (Thanks to Shattered PD)
_Potion Holder_ will group all your potions
All heroes start with the potion holder
Only applies to _new games_
_Warrior's passive skills_ nerfed
Increased mob difficulty on _Hard_
Wanted to do more but busy with something X_X, Soul blade delayed
_Soul Blade_ added
_Necro Blade_ now _tier 3_
Mages can now summon _Fire Elementals_ using the _Wand of Firebolt_!
_Nightmare_ difficulty returns
Crash fixes
Mages can now summon a random seed using the _Wand of Regrowth_!
_Soul Blade's Heal_ mana cost increased to _20_
Mages can now summon after images using the _Wand of Blink_!
Fixed bug allowing gold duplication using _Brute's hold item perk_.
_Soul Fury_ scenario added
Added _2.5D walls_!
Player can toggle between _2.5D_ and _classic_ modes in hero selection screen.
Bug fixes.
Pray for me 8')
Fixed an ugly bug where _classic mode_ freezes on inspect.
Crash fixes.
_Rodent Scouts_ added to the _Rat King_ window.
_Rodent Scouts_ roam the dungeon for you exploring.
Rodent Scouts are fragile and wake enemies up.
_Summoned Rats_ have a slightly different color now.
Fixed cropping issue in _2.5D_ mode.
_Five brightness options_ added instead of two.
New _fog of war_ added for _2.5D_ mode.
_Second Quickslot_ remains on / off between games.
_Merc Stand Ground_ option added.
When attacked or recalled, mercs will start following you again.
New games now start with a _Captured Baby Eye_ instead of rat.
Captured units have slightly different color.
Fixed _Scroll of Magic Mapping_ not properly displaying map in _2.5D_ mode.
_Skills 3.0_ released.
Each class now has a _skill tree_.
Skills can now be leveled up to _10 times_.
Some skills require _subclasses_.
All difficulties start at _1 skill point_.
Hero gains _1 skill point per level_.
Old saves skill points reset based on level.
_Tome of Mastery_ only obtained by defeating _Tenju_.
_Classic 2D mode_ is now the default game mode.
Fixed issue with black text on activity resume.
_Endurance_ bonus reduced.
_Spark_ damage increased.
_Warlock_ does 5 more damage with _Spark_.
Skill window supports _two fonts_.
Skills bonus stack reworked.
_Champions_ are more likely to drop consumables.
Minor enhancements with item descriptions.
Fixed _Fletching_ giving an arrow every tick.
Fixed mana cost on some skills.
Fixed some subclass skills giving bonus from start.
_Necroblade_ now _tier 4_ and reworked skills.
_DualSwords_ max damage decreased.
_Just Kill Me_ difficulty returns
_Aimed shot_ attack skill bonus increased.
_Awareness_ and _Kneeshot_ skills % reduced.
_Soul blade_ skills require weapon level.
Weapon drop chances reworked.
Champs loot chance now depends on difficulty.
Gold shows when buying items.
Fixed _spark_ not having cool down.
_Shadow Clone_ skill can summon _1 strong or 3 weak clones_.
_Shadow Clone_ skill cool down reduced.
New clones replace previous ones.
_Toughness_ now gives _4%_ reduction per level.
_Aggression_ bonus depends on lost health.
When cap exceeded, first summon dies.
_First floor shop_ reworked.
The _rat king_ has a friend now...
Fixed bug in _Dual Sword_ max damage.
_Gauntlet Mode_ added; Survive for as long as you can.
Fixed _Toughness_ and _Spirit armor_ reducing hunger damage.
_Gauntlet_ has chance of more rooms to be fair.
Some polishing for Gauntlet mode.
Fixed bug with _Rat King_ dying in _Gauntlet_ mode locking player in level.
_Multiplicity_ armor glyph removed from gauntlet.
Fixed regenerating while _starving_ in gauntlet.
_Gauntlet_ now has rat only mobs.
Added _Ranged Rat_ and _Rat Brute_ for gauntlet.
Fixed issue with _Shadow Clones_ breaking at high level.
Mobs will now properly target allies when hero out of reach.
Hero starts with _scroll of skill_ if _Tengu_ beaten before for that class.
Fixed _Gauntlet_ giving weaker tier armor and weapon.
Increased champ drop rate by _20%_ for all difficulties.
Grass in _Gauntlet_ mode drops _dew drops_ instead of seeds.
Fixed _Gauntlet_ not spawning _brute rats_ at higher levels.
Added _windowed mode_ on desktop, available in settings.
Escape opens the in-game menu.
Fixed problems when switching away from the game with Alt-Tab.
Added _more languages_ and translated missing text.
Improved desktop window controls and mouse-wheel scrolling.
Added the _Necromancer_ and _Mercenary_ classes, with their own skills and subclasses.
Added guns and ammunition for the Mercenary.
Added corpses for necromancy and new summons.
Fixed a memory leak.
Translated the new _Necromancer_ and _Mercenary_ skills.
Fixed Meditation's prerequisite. Raise Skeleton Archer now requires _Lich_.
Updated Android support.
Long descriptions, quests and menus now _scroll_ instead of running off-screen.
Fixed window sizing, clipped text and touch handling.
Improved mouse-wheel scrolling on desktop.
Added _keyboard and controller bindings_ in settings.
Added desktop shortcuts for movement, skills, inventory and quick slots.
Added controller navigation for menus and the dungeon.
Added optional _first-person_ and _third-person_ dungeon views.
Added desktop camera controls and a radar for the perspective views.
Switch back to the overhead view at any time.
Added _Reborn_: new dungeon layouts, encounters and boss fights.
Added special rooms and mercenaries recruited inside the dungeon.
Rebuilt _Gauntlet_ as a ten-wave arena with changing terrain and rewards.
Added _six save slots per hero_. Classic games remain available.
Boss health bars now show their phases, with shield outlines for Yog and his fists.
Added _party mode_.
Nerfed the Warrior's _Toughness_ and _Regeneration_ passives.
Buffed _champion and boss HP_ in Reborn.
Some bosses in Reborn games could already be taken out by heroes who don't want to share any glory.
Gave the title screen, HUD, menus and inspection windows the _Reborn look_. You can still use Classic visuals.
Added a new _soundtrack_ for the title screen and dungeon. Boss music blends into the current track.
Choose _Classic or Reborn music_ in settings, regardless of the visuals.
Added _HUD zoom_ and volume sliders for music and sound effects on Android and desktop.
Added a _quick-slot slider_ in Classic and Reborn: 1 to 10 slots, depending on screen space. The default is 2.
Added _Repelling_, _Serpentine_, _Crippling_, _Runic_, _Hexing_ and _Siphoning_ weapon prefixes.
Added _Stalwart_, _Vigilant_ and _Elusive_ armor prefixes.
Made inventory labels, skill descriptions and ranking details easier to read at different HUD sizes.
Control bindings and language choices use more columns in landscape. Update history fits narrow screens.
Fixed ranking and badge windows opening behind the menus. Title menus now keep your chosen HUD zoom.
Fixed grass and raised terrain drawing over heroes and thrown items. Raised objects no longer show patches of floor in first- and third-person views.
Explored terrain stays visible through fog in first- and third-person views, using your brightness setting.
Fixed caves boss crashes in older saves and dungeon generation crashes on older Android versions.
